title: Coulthart detained by CBP after Grusch story

tellings.quote: Yeah, after I did the Grusch story, I was detained and held by CBP.

plain: The journalist Ross Coulthart says that in 2023, after he reported the story of David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who claimed the US government holds hidden UFO material, he was detained and held at the US border by CBP, US Customs and Border Protection. Coulthart tells Michels this as something that happened to him, implying his reporting had drawn official attention.
